title.en: last weekend of the film festival.

line.en: the festival closes on 15 november. saturday is the last full weekend at the olympion; check filmfestival.gr for the screening you want.
line.de: das festival endet am 15. november. der samstag ist das letzte volle wochenende im olympion; das gewünschte screening auf filmfestival.gr prüfen.
line.tr: festival 15 kasım'da kapanıyor. cumartesi olympion'da son tam hafta sonu; istediğin gösterimi filmfestival.gr'den kontrol et.

sparks.why: 67th Thessaloniki International Film Festival runs 5 to 15 Nov 2026 (greekcitytimes.com); the screening on this day is not confirmed.
